description: Annex I Theme Transport Networks - Tramway stations is a dataset listed in Geoportal of the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.inspire.geoportail.lu. The dataset represents the tramway transport stations as coordinated by the Verkéiersverbond. The constantly updated data can be viewed on the geoportal (. Coverage: LU. Its keywords include opnv, trafic, INSPIRE, transport-en-commun, its, tram. The listing shows 4 download or service links in OGCFEAT, WMS, GML, ATOM. The listing shows 2026-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-lu.
